selection: Five-case convenience sample selected for varied occupations and birthplaces before inspecting their reader outputs; translations were subsequently expanded against the full plain-theme catalogue and these cases. Theodore Maiman was added after that work, before inspecting his reader output, as a presentation holdout. Selection was not blinded, random or representative; this is not a prediction-accuracy study. Birth details are reported sources, not independently authenticated records.
